positions.commentary: Google Career Certificate Program is being adopted by public school systems, with Anaheim high schools having about 800 students doing the program as part of their curriculum.

thesis: This episode argues that Google possesses unique expertise in high-demand career fields, making its career certificates a powerful tool for increasing student employability and wages. It highlights that thousands of individuals are using these certificates to upskill and switch careers, with significant adoption by institutions like the University of Texas system and Anaheim high schools.

claims.claim: Google has unique expertise in in-demand career fields and its career certificates make students more employable at higher wages.
claims.quote: where Google has unique expertise, and where we knew we could teach people in a relatively short period of time. how to become proficient for entry-level jobs and where we could do that completely online.

claims.claim: Thousands of people are upskilling themselves using Google career certificates to switch fields, and the University of Texas system is offering them to students.
claims.quote: Even at Google, there's thousands of people upskilling themselves using the Google career certificates who just want to get into a different field. Maybe they want to become a U.X designer or they want to become a program manager.

claims.claim: The University of Texas system is using Google Career certificates to help students become more employable at higher wages, with 2,500 students currently doing the program.
claims.quote: And so it's really exciting to see what the U.T. system is doing, and even within a very short period of time, I think there's 2,500 students at the U.T. system doing the Google career certificate program on top of their degrees.

claims.claim: Google Career Certificate Program is being adopted by public school systems, with Anaheim high schools having about 800 students doing the program as part of their curriculum.
claims.quote: One great example is an age. Anaheim, California. They, I think, have about 800 high school students doing the Google Career Certificate Program as part of their high school curriculum.

numbers.what: increase in AI-related courses and foundational courses related to AI in the last year
numbers.quote: We've seen a in the last year, in about a 33% increase in AI-related courses. And we had exactly the same increase in foundational courses related to AI.

numbers.what: people trained in Egypt through a program running for two years
numbers.quote: with this program has been running for two years, we've trained up about 150,000 people in Egypt now.

numbers.what: annualized foreign currency brought back into Egypt through a program
numbers.quote: That's now bringing annualized about $200 million of foreign currency back into Egypt. Just through that program.

numbers.what: percentage of jobs in the U.S. requiring a college degree
numbers.quote: About 80% of jobs in the U.S. and similar in other countries that pay well, say they require a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans earning a college degree
numbers.quote: But in our country, actually, only about a third of Americans earn a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans not earning a college degree
numbers.quote: So that leaves two-thirds of our country, basically locked out of every good-paying job.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans who don't know their schedule for the following week
numbers.quote: About a quarter of Americans don't even know their schedule for the following week.

numbers.what: percentage growth in cyber attacks last year
numbers.quote: As a matter of fact, they grew 38% last year.

numbers.what: number of open cybersecurity jobs in the U.S.
numbers.quote: In the U.S., I think the number is 650,000 open jobs in cybersecurity.

numbers.what: expected global gap in cybersecurity jobs
numbers.quote: I think the number in the world, they're expecting to have a gap of about three and a half million open jobs.

numbers.what: hours of content in the certificate programs
numbers.quote: Usually have from 100 to 150 hours of content.

numbers.what: timeframe for most people to finish the programs
numbers.quote: So most people finish in somewhere between three and six months.

numbers.what: growth rate of demand for data analytics skills compared to other skills
numbers.quote: research shows that demand for data analytics skills is growing 15 times faster than the average demand for other skills.

numbers.what: percentage of CEOs citing finding skilled people as a top inhibitor to growth
numbers.quote: You and I started by talking about employers, and I think the PWC survey, four out of five CEOs, say that the number one inhibitor, or one of the top few inhibitors to their growth, is finding people with the skills they need.

numbers.quote: One great example is an age. Anaheim, California. They, I think, have about 800 high school students doing the Google Career Certificate Program as part of their high school curriculum.

numbers.what: number of students at the University of Texas system doing the Google career certificate program
numbers.quote: And even within a very short period of time, I think there's 2,500 students at the U.T. system doing the Google career certificate program on top of their degrees.

numbers.what: shelf life of technical skills
numbers.quote: Recently, IBM reported that technical skills have a shelf life of about two and a half years.

numbers.quote: About 80% of jobs in the U.S. and similar in other countries that pay well, say they require a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans earning a college degree
numbers.quote: But in our country, actually only about a third of Americans earn a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of jobs existing today that did not exist in 1940
numbers.quote: Consider this. A staggering 60% of jobs that exist today, were non-existent in 1940.

numbers.what: percentage of population working in farming around 1800
numbers.quote: If you look at farming, around 1800, you had 90% of the population working in farming,

numbers.what: percentage of population working in farming around 1950
numbers.quote: around 1950 at the time that you just cited, I think it was down to about 20%

numbers.what: percentage of population working in farming today
numbers.quote: and today we're seeing about 1, 1.5%.

numbers.what: percentage of workers in 2018 with jobs that did not exist in 1940
numbers.quote: But a recent report from economist David O'Tor shows that actually 60% of workers in 2018 have jobs that actually did not exist in 1940.

numbers.what: number of Fortune 2000 companies Udacity works with
numbers.quote: We have about 140,000 fortune 2,000 companies that we work with.
